notes.frame: Head and shoulders are the centerlines of Phosphor's user-plus, -minus and -check (head r 60 at 108, 100; the shoulders an arc of r 108.2 from 24, 200 to 192, 200). Not set as frame, because Phosphor has no icon with only this part.
notes.drawing: The x sits on the centre of user-plus's plus (224, 136) and is 40 units wide, five sixths of the plus, the way Phosphor's phone-x is smaller than phone-plus.
notes.bold: The x is 34 units wide and 2 units further left, as user-plus shortens its plus in bold to stay inside the grid.
